hook.text_top: Two war machines just leveled Times Square.
hook.text_bottom: Watch what that cut does to him...
hook.voice: Two war machines just leveled Times Square.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Starts already mid-action. Camera low at street level: A skids backward, boots tearing a trench in the asphalt, then the camera swings up behind A's shoulder.
shots.voice: Shot 1. Start already mid-action, low on the street, then swing up behind his shoulder into the sky.

shots.excerpt: Wide lateral tracking shot: A and B meet in midair above an intersection; B dissolves into black mist. Sharp upward pan: A against a gigantic blue LED billboard.
shots.voice: Shot 2. A wide lateral tracking shot keeps both fighters readable while the reaper vanishes into black mist.

shots.excerpt: Interior of an empty dim office: the room fills with a rolling gray dust cloud under a flickering fluorescent tube; A lands in a low sliding crouch.
shots.voice: Shot 4. A quick cut inside a dusty office gives the chaos a breath before he bursts back out.

shots.excerpt: Medium tracking shot between the buildings: A and B collide in midair; the crimson scythe blade sweeps over A's head; A spins head-over-heels.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A medium tracking shot right inside the midair duel, with the scythe sweeping overhead.

shots.excerpt: Top-down drone view looking straight down at the street: A drops from a rooftop ledge, katanas out, toward a fresh round crater in the asphalt.
shots.voice: Shot 8. A top-down drone view shows the height of the fall and the crater waiting below.

shots.excerpt: Slow motion. Locked-off close-up on B's ivory deer-skull mask, katana flat across the frame; the red eyes go dark and the mask splits down the middle.
highlight: the mask splits down the middle
shots.voice: Shot 9. Everything slows down. A locked close-up as the red eyes die and the mask splits open.
